newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Michelin to pick up more RSS3 rubber in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Michelin to pick up more RSS3 rubber in Singapore.

text.p: Michelin is said poised to buy several hundred tonnes of RSS3 rubber on Wednesday, but others were more cautious after Tokyo rubber futures slid on long liquidation, dealers said.
"I believe Michelin will buy some more RSS3 rubber and it may reach a few hundred tonnes. The rest of the market seems very cautious at the moment," a dealer said.

Prices in the market received a boost over the past few days after Michelin bought several hundred tonnes of RSS3 rubber. Bridgestone was also reported to have purchased a consignment of TSR20 rubber.
Except for Michelin's interest, the buying seems to have slowed down, dealers said.

"Bridgestone said they're not interested at the prices they are seeing. I don't think Goodyear is in this market either," a trader said. "It's pretty quiet after Japan dropped this afternoon. The short-term looks tight, but people are cautious."
"People are waiting for some direction in the market so some of them are on the sidelines," another dealer said.
At around 0900 GMT, September RSS3 was seen at 92.50 U.S. cents a kg from 94.25 cents. October TSR20 was seen at 99.50 U.S. cents a kg from 101.00 cents. - Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
